title.zh: 先保证每个长度的配分和严格为正
title.en: First establish positivity at every length

given.zh: 长度固定时自避游走集合有限；ρ>0，指数权重 exp(s·Re(conj(e)·Δγ)) 始终为正。
given.en: At fixed length there are finitely many self-avoiding walks; ρ>0 and every exponential weight exp(s·Re(conj(e)·Δγ)) is positive.

claim.zh: 任意 o 和 n 都有 Zₒ(n)>0，因此后面可对配分和不等式取对数，并使用 log(ab)=log a+log b。
claim.en: For every o and n, Zₒ(n)>0. We may therefore take logarithms of partition inequalities and use log(ab)=log a+log b.

statement.zh: rank(γⱼ)=rank(o)+j，因此 j≠k 时 γⱼ≠γₖ。
statement.en: rank(γⱼ)=rank(o)+j, so γⱼ≠γₖ whenever j≠k.

reason.zh: 取 spine 的前 n 步；每走一步 spineRank 增加一，所以不可能重复经过某个顶点。
reason.en: Take the first n spine steps. Each increases spineRank by one, preventing any repeated vertex.

statement.zh: 这条 γ 的权重为 ρⁿexp(s·Re(conj(e)·Δγ))>0。
statement.en: The weight of this γ is ρⁿexp(s·Re(conj(e)·Δγ))>0.

reason.zh: ρ 是正数，任意实数的指数也严格为正；n=0 时同样得到一项权重为一的空游走。
reason.en: The factor ρ is positive and a real exponential is strictly positive. At n=0 the empty walk contributes weight one.

statement.zh: Zₒ(n)≥weight(γ)>0，后面所有 log Zₒ(n) 都有正的真数。
statement.en: Zₒ(n)≥weight(γ)>0, so every later log Zₒ(n) has a positive argument.

reason.zh: γ 属于有限求和集合，且其它权重非负，保留这一项就得到严格正下界。
reason.en: The walk γ belongs to the finite summation set and all other weights are nonnegative, so retaining this term gives strict positivity.

title.zh: 同类起点的配分和完全相同
title.en: Starting points in the same class have identical partition sums

given.zh: 两个起点 o、o′ 的 up 标记相同，则它们相差一个整格平移。
given.en: If o and o′ have the same up flag, an integer lattice translation takes one to the other.

claim.zh: 对所有 n，Zₒ(n)=Zₒ′(n)。后续只需保留两个标准起点 up(0,0) 和 down(0,0)。
claim.en: For every n, Zₒ(n)=Zₒ′(n). It is enough to retain the two representatives up(0,0) and down(0,0).

statement.zh: 选整格向量 z 使 T_z(o)=o′，并对游走逐点作 T_z。
statement.en: Choose an integer lattice vector z with T_z(o)=o′ and translate each vertex of a walk by T_z.

reason.zh: 同类起点具有相同的 up 标记，位置之差恰由整格平移实现；平移保持每条邻接边。
reason.en: The equal up flags make the displacement an integer lattice translation, which preserves every adjacency.

statement.zh: T₋z∘T_z=id，且 Δ(T_zγ)=(endpoint+z)−(start+z)=Δγ。
statement.en: T₋z∘T_z=id and Δ(T_zγ)=(endpoint+z)−(start+z)=Δγ.

reason.zh: 逆平移同时还原顶点互异性与整条路径；起终点增加的 z 在位移中抵消。
reason.en: Inverse translation recovers the whole path and preserves distinctness. The added z cancels from the endpoint-minus-start displacement.

statement.zh: weight(T_zγ)=weight(γ)，故 Σγ weight(T_zγ)=Zₒ(n)=Zₒ′(n)。
statement.en: weight(T_zγ)=weight(γ), hence reindexing the sum gives Zₒ(n)=Zₒ′(n).

reason.zh: 长度和位移都没有改变，配分和的两个参数也相同，因此双射下每个求和项逐一相等。
reason.en: Length, displacement and parameters remain unchanged, so corresponding terms are equal under the bijection of walk sets.

title.zh: 拆分游走，把长配分和压到乘积下面
title.en: Split a walk to bound a long partition sum by a product

given.zh: 把 m+n 步自避游走 γ 拆成前 m 步 α 与从其中间顶点出发的后 n 步 β。
given.en: Split an (m+n)-step self-avoiding walk γ into an m-step prefix α and an n-step suffix β starting at the intermediate vertex.

statement.zh: γ↦(α,β) 是单射，Δγ=Δα+Δβ。
statement.en: The split γ↦(α,β) is injective, with Δγ=Δα+Δβ.

reason.zh: 保留前 m 步和后 n 步就能恢复全部顶点；中间顶点在两段的位移相加时抵消。
reason.en: The prefix and suffix determine all vertices of γ, and the intermediate vertex cancels when their displacements are added.

statement.zh: ρᵐ⁺ⁿexp(s·proj(Δα+Δβ))=weight(α)·weight(β)。
statement.en: ρᵐ⁺ⁿexp(s·proj(Δα+Δβ))=weight(α)·weight(β).

reason.zh: 投影对位移可加，再用 ρᵐ⁺ⁿ=ρᵐρⁿ 和 exp(a+b)=exp(a)exp(b) 分开权重。
reason.en: The projection is additive; powers and the exponential of a sum then factor the weight into the two segment weights.

statement.zh: Zₒ(m+n)≤Σα weight(α)·Z_endpoint(α)(n)。
statement.en: Zₒ(m+n)≤Σα weight(α)·Z_endpoint(α)(n).

reason.zh: 把后缀扩展到所有从中点出发的自避游走，会加入一些与前缀相交的组合。新增项非负，因此给出上界。
reason.en: Allow every self-avoiding suffix from the intermediate vertex, including suffixes meeting the prefix. The added terms are nonnegative, so this enlarges the sum.

statement.zh: Z_endpoint(α)(n)≤Mₙ=max{Zup(n),Zdown(n)}，故 Zₒ(m+n)≤Zₒ(m)Mₙ。
statement.en: Z_endpoint(α)(n)≤Mₙ=max{Zup(n),Zdown(n)}, giving Zₒ(m+n)≤Zₒ(m)Mₙ.

reason.zh: 每个中点属于两类之一，同类平移把其配分和换成相应标准值；公共上界 Mₙ 可以提出前缀求和。
reason.en: Each intermediate vertex belongs to one of the two classes. Translation replaces its sum by the representative value, and the common bound Mₙ factors out of the prefix sum.

title.zh: 偶数步回到同类，得到真正的次可加性
title.en: Even prefixes return to the same class and give subadditivity

given.zh: 蜂窝图每走一条边都会翻转 up 标记，因此任意 2p 步前缀的终点与 c 同类。
given.en: Every honeycomb edge flips the up flag, so the endpoint of a 2p-step prefix has the same class as c.

claim.zh: Zc(2(p+q))≤Zc(2p)Zc(2q)，故 uₚ₊q≤uₚ+u_q，其中 uₚ=log Zc(2p)。up、down 两类分别满足这个结论。
claim.en: Zc(2(p+q))≤Zc(2p)Zc(2q), hence uₚ₊q≤uₚ+u_q for uₚ=log Zc(2p). This holds separately for both up and down classes.

statement.zh: up(endpoint(α))=up(c)，只要 α 的长度是 2p。
statement.en: up(endpoint(α))=up(c) whenever α has length 2p.

reason.zh: 每条蜂窝图边翻转一次标记，偶数次翻转回到原标记，与前缀的具体形状无关。
reason.en: Each edge flips the flag once, so an even number of flips restores it regardless of the prefix shape.

statement.zh: Z_endpoint(α)(2q)=Zc(2q)，故 Zc(2p+2q)≤Zc(2p)Zc(2q)。
statement.en: Z_endpoint(α)(2q)=Zc(2q), hence Zc(2p+2q)≤Zc(2p)Zc(2q).

reason.zh: 前一步的拆分和中，每个后缀因子现在都等于同一个标准值，因此直接提出该值，不再需要最大值。
reason.en: Every suffix factor in the split sum now equals the same representative value, so it can be factored out without taking a maximum.

statement.zh: uₚ₊q=log Zc(2(p+q))≤log Zc(2p)+log Zc(2q)=uₚ+u_q。
statement.en: uₚ₊q=log Zc(2(p+q))≤log Zc(2p)+log Zc(2q)=uₚ+u_q.

reason.zh: 两因子严格为正，允许用 log 的单调性及乘积公式；对 up 和 down 分别应用同一计算。
reason.en: Both factors are positive, so monotonicity of log and its product formula apply. Perform this calculation separately for up and down.

title.zh: 一条直线游走阻止对数增长率掉到负无穷
title.en: One explicit walk prevents the logarithmic rate from falling to minus infinity

given.zh: 从任一标准起点 c 沿 spine 走 2p 步，终点相对起点的位移是实数 p；该游走没有重复顶点。
given.en: The spine walk of length 2p from either representative c has displacement p along the real axis and has no repeated vertices.

claim.zh: Zc(2p)≥ρ²ᵖexp(−|s|p|Re e|)，所以对 p≥1 有 uₚ/p≥2logρ−|s||Re e|。
claim.en: Zc(2p)≥ρ²ᵖexp(−|s|p|Re e|), so for p≥1, uₚ/p≥2logρ−|s||Re e|.

statement.zh: 选 2p 步 spine 游走 γ，则 Δγ=p，投影为 p·Re e。
statement.en: Choose the 2p-step spine walk γ. Then Δγ=p and its projection is p·Re e.

reason.zh: 源码分别计算了 up、down 起点的偶数步终点；两种情形减去各自起点后都得到实位移 p。
reason.en: The source computes the even-step endpoint for each starting class. Subtracting its respective starting position gives real displacement p in both cases.

statement.zh: s·p·Re e≥−|s·p·Re e|=−|s|p|Re e|。
statement.en: s·p·Re e≥−|s·p·Re e|=−|s|p|Re e|.

reason.zh: 使用实数总不小于其绝对值的相反数，再用 p≥0 去掉 |p|。这对任意正负参数 s 都成立。
reason.en: Every real number is at least minus its absolute value. Since p≥0, |p|=p; the inequality allows either sign of s.

statement.zh: Zc(2p)≥weight(γ)≥ρ²ᵖexp(−|s|p|Re e|)。
statement.en: Zc(2p)≥weight(γ)≥ρ²ᵖexp(−|s|p|Re e|).

reason.zh: 先用单个求和项下估配分和，再用指数函数的单调性把上一行代入权重。
reason.en: Bound the sum below by one term, then use monotonicity of the exponential to apply the preceding inequality to its weight.

statement.zh: p≥1 时 uₚ/p≥2logρ−|s||Re e|；加入 p=0 后可统一用 min{0,2logρ−|s||Re e|}。
statement.en: For p≥1, uₚ/p≥2logρ−|s||Re e|; including p=0 gives the common lower bound min{0,2logρ−|s||Re e|}.

reason.zh: 对严格正的下界取对数，把 log(ρ²ᵖ) 化成 2p logρ，再除以 p。源码在 p=0 时的商为零，所以用 min 把该项一并纳入。
reason.en: Take logarithms of the positive bound, expand log(ρ²ᵖ)=2p logρ and divide by p. The formal quotient at p=0 is zero, so taking the minimum includes that term too.

title.zh: Fekete 给出偶子列的有限极限
title.en: Fekete yields a finite limit for the even subsequence

given.zh: uₚ=log Zc(2p) 次可加，且 uₚ/p 在实数中有下界。
given.en: The sequence uₚ=log Zc(2p) is subadditive and uₚ/p is bounded below in ℝ.

claim.zh: 存在有限 A∈ℝ 使 uₚ/p→A，因此 b₂ₚ=log Zc(2p)/(2p)→A/2。
claim.en: There is a finite A∈ℝ with uₚ/p→A, and therefore b₂ₚ=log Zc(2p)/(2p)→A/2.

statement.zh: uₚ₊q≤uₚ+u_q，且 {uₚ/p:p∈ℕ} 在 ℝ 中有下界。
statement.en: uₚ₊q≤uₚ+u_q and {uₚ/p:p∈ℕ} is bounded below in ℝ.

reason.zh: 把偶数长度的乘积上界与 spine 的对数下界并在一起，恰好得到源码 Fekete 引理需要的两个假设。
reason.en: The even-length product bound and the spine logarithmic bound supply exactly the two hypotheses of the Fekete lemma used in the source.

statement.zh: 由此存在 A∈ℝ，使 uₚ/p→A。
statement.en: Consequently there is A∈ℝ such that uₚ/p→A.

reason.zh: 次可加性给出归一化极限，下界排除向负无穷发散；u₁ 本身有限又提供有限上界。
reason.en: Subadditivity gives the normalized limit. The lower bound rules out divergence to minus infinity, while the finite value u₁ supplies a finite upper bound.

statement.zh: p≥1 时 b₂ₚ=log Zc(2p)/(2p)=(uₚ/p)/2，因此 b₂ₚ→A/2。
statement.en: For p≥1, b₂ₚ=log Zc(2p)/(2p)=(uₚ/p)/2, so b₂ₚ→A/2.

reason.zh: Fekete 除的是指标 p，题目除的是实际步数 2p；这一个二倍尺度必须保留到极限中。
reason.en: Fekete divides by the index p, whereas the target divides by the actual length 2p. The factor of two must therefore remain in the limit.

title.zh: 用单步代价夹住每个奇数长度
title.en: Squeeze odd lengths using a fixed one-step cost

given.zh: 取 M=max{Zup(1),Zdown(1)}>0，C=log M。拆分不等式给出 Zc(2p+1)≤Zc(2p)M 及 Zc(2p+2)≤Zc(2p+1)M。
given.en: Set M=max{Zup(1),Zdown(1)}>0 and C=log M. Splitting gives Zc(2p+1)≤Zc(2p)M and Zc(2p+2)≤Zc(2p+1)M.

statement.zh: Zc(2p+1)≤Zc(2p)M，且 Zc(2p+2)≤Zc(2p+1)M。
statement.en: Zc(2p+1)≤Zc(2p)M and Zc(2p+2)≤Zc(2p+1)M.

reason.zh: 在拆分上界中把后段长度固定为一；分别从偶数长度和奇数长度拆出这一步。M>0 是两类一步配分和的最大值。
reason.en: Fix suffix length one in the split bound, once after an even prefix and once after an odd prefix. The positive M is the maximum of the two one-step partition sums.

statement.zh: log Zc(2p+2)−C≤log Zc(2p+1)≤log Zc(2p)+C，其中 C=log M。
statement.en: log Zc(2p+2)−C≤log Zc(2p+1)≤log Zc(2p)+C, with C=log M.

reason.zh: 各配分和为正，可以取对数。左界来自第二条不等式移项；C 无须假设非负。
reason.en: Positivity permits taking logarithms. Rearranging the second inequality gives the lower bound; C need not be nonnegative.

reason.zh: 分母严格为正，不等号方向保持；把两侧的对数分别改写成偶数长度的归一化值。
reason.en: The denominator is positive, preserving both inequalities. Rewrite the two outer logarithms as their normalized even-length values.

statement.zh: 两侧都趋于 A/2，因为两个比值→1、C/(2p+1)→0；故 b₂ₚ₊₁→A/2。
statement.en: Both outer expressions tend to A/2: the ratios tend to 1 and C/(2p+1) tends to 0. Hence b₂ₚ₊₁→A/2.

reason.zh: b₂ₚ 与其移位 b₂ₚ₊₂ 具有相同极限。将上下界夹到一起，就补上了偶数子列没有覆盖的全部奇数长度。
reason.en: The even subsequence and its one-index shift have the same limit. The squeeze theorem therefore supplies all the odd lengths missing from the even subsequence.

title.zh: 合并奇偶，再回到任意起点
title.en: Combine parities and return to any starting point

given.zh: 对每个标准起点 c，b₂ₚ 与 b₂ₚ₊₁ 都趋于其对应的 A/2；任意 o 与其中一个 c 同类。
given.en: For each representative c, both b₂ₚ and b₂ₚ₊₁ tend to its corresponding A/2. Every o belongs to one of the two classes.

claim.zh: log Zₒ(n)/n 在全部自然数长度上收敛，并且极限就是定义中的 freeEnergy(o,e,s)。
claim.en: The full sequence log Zₒ(n)/n converges, and its limit is exactly the defined freeEnergy(o,e,s).

statement.zh: 给定 ε>0，分别取 P₀、P₁，使 p≥P₀ 时 |b₂ₚ−A/2|<ε，p≥P₁ 时 |b₂ₚ₊₁−A/2|<ε。
statement.en: Given ε>0, choose P₀ and P₁ so the even error is below ε for p≥P₀ and the odd error is below ε for p≥P₁.

reason.zh: 这是两条子列收敛的定义；它们进入同一个极限 A/2 的邻域，但可以有不同的进入时间。
reason.en: This is convergence of the two subsequences. They approach the same A/2 neighbourhood, possibly after different thresholds.

statement.zh: 令 P=max{P₀,P₁}。n≥2P 时写成 n=2p 或 n=2p+1，均有 p≥P。
statement.en: Set P=max{P₀,P₁}. For n≥2P, write n=2p or n=2p+1; in either case p≥P.

reason.zh: 自然数的奇偶分解覆盖全部 n，因此两条子列的共同尾部控制整个序列的尾部。
reason.en: The parity decomposition covers every natural number, so their common tails control the entire sequence tail.

statement.zh: 若 o 与标准起点 c 同类，则 log Zₒ(n)/n=log Zc(n)/n→A_c/2。
statement.en: If o and representative c have the same class, log Zₒ(n)/n=log Zc(n)/n→A_c/2.

reason.zh: 同类平移给出逐项相等，所以收敛直接传回 o。A_c 可以依赖起点类别，这里不需要比较两类极限。
reason.en: Translation gives termwise equality and transfers convergence to o. The value A_c may depend on the starting class; no comparison of the two class limits is required.

statement.zh: 该序列既然趋于实数极限，其 limUnder 就等于这个极限，即 freeEnergy(o,e,s)。
statement.en: Since the sequence has a real limit, its limUnder equals that limit, namely freeEnergy(o,e,s).

reason.zh: 最后才使用 freeEnergy 的定义识别极限值；没有在收敛证明之前假定 limUnder 自动具有极限性质。
reason.en: Only after proving convergence do we identify the limit using the definition of freeEnergy; the definition of limUnder alone was not used as a convergence claim.
